summary: plan-local validator identity helper; PLAN resolves parent plan dir; _CANDIDATE_SOURCES maps slice ids R0-R4 to relative source files, with R2 allowing either of two knowledge_context paths and R4 duplicating acceptance_cli; _identity reads implementation-contract.v1.json and command-registry.v1.json, hashes plan_id plus optional slice object plus registry plus terminal into validator_hash; unknown slice_id raises ValueError; current_candidate_identity requires defined sources, hashes each listed file with relative-path prefix into candidate_hash; validation_snapshot adds candidate_hash from implementation-contract.v1.json plus predicate_input_root, authority_root, validator_root, validator_version, closure_definition_hash from repair/round-1/repair-closure.json; slice_validation_snapshot merges snapshot with one slice identity; ambiguity: snapshot candidate_hash is contract-file hash, not candidate-source hash
